title: Phellinus igniarius targets HIF1A to regulate HK2 and inhibit metabolic reprogramming in acute myeloid leukemia.
authors: Li, Zhongyu; Tan, Yuanyuan; Xie, Zhibin; Su, Guizhen; Yao, Wei; Liu, Guiling; Li, Jiajia
one_liner_zh: 研究药用真菌桑黄通过HIF1A-HK2轴抑制AML代谢重编程，涉及HIF1A与HK2启动子结合，但核心是疾病治疗机制，非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅分子对接且无AI/物理模拟深度。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Phellinus igniarius is a medicinal fungus with anti-cancer activity. Its role in solid tumors has been widely reported, but the mechanism of action on hematological malignancies, especially acute myeloid leukemia (AML), remains unclear. This study aims to explore the molecular mechanism by which Phellinus igniarius inhibits AML. METHOD: The effects of Phellinus igniarius on the proliferation, migration and apoptosis of HL60 cells were detected by CCK-8, transwell and flow cytometry respectively. The expression and metabolic activity of glycolytic-related proteins were analyzed by Western blot, extracellular acidification rate (ECAR) detection and Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assays (ELISA). The nude mouse transplanted tumor model was established to observe the inhibitory effect of Phellinus igniarius on tumor growth, and the proliferation and apoptosis in vivo were analyzed by Ki67 and TUNEL staining. RESULT: Phellinus igniarius can significantly inhibit the progression of AML both in vivo and in vitro, and down-regulate the expression of key glycolytic enzymes (PGK1, PKM2, GLUT1). The active ingredient ergotamine of Phellinus igniarius and its key target HIF1A were screened out by network pharmacology and molecular docking. Mechanism studies have shown that Phellinus igniarius blocks the transcriptional activation of glycolysis by inhibiting the binding of HIF1A to the HK2 promoter. CONCLUSION: This study reveals that Phellinus igniarius inhibits AML metabolic reprogramming by targeting the HIF1A-HK2 axis, providing a new potential strategy for AML treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：桑黄（Phellinus igniarius）是一种具有抗癌活性的药用真菌。其在实体瘤中的作用已被广泛报道，但对血液系统恶性肿瘤，尤其是急性髓系白血病（acute myeloid leukemia, AML）的作用机制仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨桑黄抑制AML的分子机制。方法：通过CCK-8、transwell和流式细胞术分别检测桑黄对HL60细胞增殖、迁移和凋亡的影响。通过Western blot、细胞外酸化率（ECAR）检测和酶联免疫吸附试验（ELISA）分析糖酵解相关蛋白的表达及代谢活性。建立裸鼠移植瘤模型观察桑黄对肿瘤生长的抑制作用，并通过Ki67和TUNEL染色分析体内增殖和凋亡情况。结果：桑黄在体内外均能显著抑制AML的进展，并下调关键糖酵解酶（PGK1、PKM2、GLUT1）的表达。通过网络药理学和分子对接筛选出桑黄的活性成分麦角胺及其关键靶点HIF1A。机制研究表明，桑黄通过抑制HIF1A与HK2启动子的结合，阻断糖酵解的转录激活。结论：本研究揭示桑黄通过靶向HIF1A-HK2轴抑制AML代谢重编程，为AML治疗提供了新的潜在策略。
